statements.quote: Our book of business for watsonx and generative AI again showed strong momentum, growing quarter over quarter, and has now eclipsed one billion dollars since we launched watsonx in mid-2023.
statements.notes: 'Book of business' combines bookings/signings with revenue, so it is not recognized revenue. It is cumulative from mid-2023 through Q1 2024 and spans two fiscal years. 'Eclipsed one billion dollars' means more than $1 billion, recorded as a lower bound. The filing gives no fiscal year; do not treat this as fiscal 2024 AI revenue without review.
